description:
Activate Relic of Legends's second ability by tapping Amazing Spider-Girl, adding one mana of the color needed to cast Spider-Man.
Cast Spider-Man for its web-slinging cost (reduced through the templated card) by paying one mana and returning Amazing Spider-Girl to your hand.
Activate Relic of Legends's second ability by tapping Spider-Man, adding one mana of the color needed to cast Amazing Spider-Girl.
Cast Amazing Spider-Girl for its web-slinging cost by paying one mana and returning Spider-Man to your hand.
Repeat.
